title: Order Fulfillment REST API Endpoint Review
description: Inspect an order checkout endpoint for optional field null dereferences, unpaginated full table query memory risks, and raw exception stack trace leaks.

defects.title: Unhandled Optional Address Null Dereference
defects.consequence: Subscripting order.shipping_address without null checking raises TypeError when client submits payload without optional shipping details.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Validate that shipping_address is not None before subscripting or use safe dictionary access like (order.shipping_address or {}).get('pincode').

defects.title: Unpaginated Full Table Query in API Handler
defects.consequence: Loading all historical orders into server process memory causes extreme latency and Out-Of-Memory termination under high production data volumes.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Apply parameterized pagination (LIMIT and OFFSET or cursor pagination) and filter by user_id.

defects.title: Internal Database Stack Trace Exposure in Response
defects.consequence: Returning raw traceback strings reveals internal schema details, table names, and filesystem paths to potential attackers.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Return generic error message with unique correlation ID and log the detailed traceback server-side.

instructions: Inspect the checkout API endpoint for unhandled null references, unpaginated data queries, and sensitive stack trace leakage. Flag flawed line numbers and select correct defect classifications.
disclaimer: Technical practice scenario for capability self-reflection and professional development (Rules R-CR-08, R-CR-11).
